INSERT INTO voc.raw_reviews (
    content_key,
    platform,
    shop_id,
    shop_name,
    content_id,

    product_id,
    product_name,
    sku_id,
    sku_name,

    content_text,
    content_time,

    product_rating,
    service_rating,
    logistics_rating,
    rating_scale_max,
    rating_label,

    content_type,
    root_review_id,
    parent_content_id,

    author_id,
    author_role,

    data_source,
    processing_status,

    source_staging_id,
    source_review_id
)
VALUES (
    $1,
    $2,
    NULL,
    $3,
    $4,

    $5,
    $6,
    $7,
    $8,

    $9,
    $10,

    $11,
    NULL,
    NULL,
    $12,
    $13,

    $14,
    $15,
    $16,

    $17,
    $18,

    'Browser',
    'NEW',

    $19,
    $20
)
ON CONFLICT (content_key)
DO NOTHING
RETURNING
    raw_id,
    content_key,
    content_id,
    content_type,
    processing_status,
    source_staging_id;

UPDATE voc.review_source_staging
SET
    processing_status = 'PROCESSED',
    processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    error_message = NULL
WHERE collector_run_id = $1
  AND processing_status = 'NEW'
RETURNING
    staging_id,
    collector_run_id,
    review_id,
    processing_status,
    processed_at;

WITH next_run AS (
    SELECT
        s.collector_run_id
    FROM voc.review_source_staging s
    JOIN voc.collector_runs cr
      ON cr.run_id = s.collector_run_id
    WHERE s.processing_status = 'NEW'
      AND cr.status = 'SUCCESS'
    GROUP BY
        s.collector_run_id,
        cr.finished_at
    ORDER BY cr.finished_at ASC
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    s.*,

    -- 显式保留源业务时间字符串，
    -- 避免 n8n JSON 显示为 UTC 后再拿去生成 content_id
    TO_CHAR(
        s.review_time,
        'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
    ) AS review_time_local,

    CASE
        WHEN s.append_review_time IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE TO_CHAR(
            s.append_review_time,
            'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'
        )
    END AS append_review_time_local,

    -- Canonical 层是否已经存在首评事件
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM voc.raw_reviews r
        WHERE r.platform = s.platform
          AND COALESCE(r.shop_name, '') = COALESCE(s.shop_name, '')
          AND r.source_review_id = s.review_id
          AND r.content_type = 'INITIAL_REVIEW'
    ) AS initial_exists,

    -- Canonical 层是否已经存在这条具体追评事件
    CASE
        WHEN s.append_review_text IS NULL
          OR s.append_review_time IS NULL
        THEN FALSE

        ELSE EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM voc.raw_reviews r
            WHERE r.platform = s.platform
              AND COALESCE(r.shop_name, '') = COALESCE(s.shop_name, '')
              AND r.source_review_id = s.review_id
              AND r.content_type = 'FOLLOWUP_REVIEW'
              AND r.content_time = s.append_review_time
        )
    END AS followup_exists

FROM voc.review_source_staging s
WHERE s.collector_run_id = (
    SELECT collector_run_id
    FROM next_run
)
  AND s.processing_status = 'NEW'

ORDER BY s.source_row_no;
